title: Gibus of the Worshipful Servant

sources.title: Lickspittle's Alertness
markers: | summary = '''Lickspittle's Alertness''' is a passive feature that increases the wearer's speed at the start of combat.

sources.title: Multitasking
markers: | summary = '''Multitasking''' is a passive feature that improves the wearer's ability to hold onto concentrating on a spell.

summary: Gain advantage on Concentration saves and Momentum based on your Charisma modifier at the start of combat.

fields.Momentum: Gain one turn per point of Charisma modifier, up to five turns. Movement speed increases by 5 ft per remaining turn. Slowed can end Momentum early.
fields.Late entry: The start-of-combat trigger runs at the start of a combat round. Joining partway through defers the grant to the next round.
fields.Base value: 35 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and pinned item and dependency revisions.
